Name: Agartha
Entry:
A massive flying fortress created in ancient times by the Obscurian people. Incorportated as a self-governing city-state of Armica.

The structure of Agartha is a massive, metallic sphere 25 miles in diameter, flanked by large wing structures. The structure is broken into several layered strata broken into two halves: the surface layers (broken further into Upper Agartha and Lower Agartha) where the majoriy of people live, and the subterranean Ruins. 

{br}
Many of the underlying mechanics of Agartha are not yet completely understood However, researchers and engineers have managed to restore many of the key functions of the city, including:
  -Autonomous flight
  -Internal weather and artificial sunlight control
  -Atmospheric water collection

Such features have allowed long term colonization and habitation of Agartha, primarily by Armican citizens. As of 2030, the city houses over a million people.

Name: Lower Agartha
Entry: The lower stratum of the city of Agartha. Built and augmented from the existing infrastructure of Agartha. Contains a combination of residential districts interspersed with commercial and restaurant sectors. Due to the crowded conditions, personal transportation is rarely used, and most Agarthans rely on the dense network of trains centered on Seven Stars Station.

Name: Upper Agartha
Entry: The upper stratum of the city of Agartha. The stratum was constructed completely after Armica colonized the city, and contains many of the administrative and financial sectors of the city.

Name: AEIOU HQ - Iconoclasts Branch Office
Entry: Contained within the highest floors of AEIOU HQ still Lower Agartha.

Name: AEIOU HQ - Ostanes Branch Office
Entry: Ground floor of Lower Agartha - one of the first established branches of AEIOU, created in collaboration with tech conglomerate Ostanes.

Name: AEIOU HQ - Underdogs Branch Office
Entry: Basement offices beneath the Ostanes Branch of AEIOU. Very difficult to find.

Name: Orchid Palace Apartments
Entry: Lower Agarthan housing complex. In-unit washer/dryer. 15 minute walk from the nearest metro station. Cheap rent!

Name: Seven Stars Station
Entry: The largest train station in Lower Agartha, serving all major lines A through F, acting as a central hub for the city.

Name: End of the Line
Entry: The main entrance to the Ruins - a gargantuan hole leading directly into the First Layer of the Ruins. A single train line owned by AEIOU runs across the diameter of the hole, equipped with cranes to lower equipment and personnel down into the Ruins.

Name: Typocry-Pho
Entry: An authentic noodle restaurant located in Lower Agartha. Family-owned. Affordable prices.

Name: Base Camp Alpha
Entry: The initial staging area for expeditions into the Ruins. Abandoned construction materials and equipment can be seen left scattered about - remnants of failed expansion projects into the Ruins.

Name: AEIOU HQ - Admin Branch Office
Entry: The top floors of AEIOU where the administrative body of Agartha works.

Name: Coil
Entry: An enclosed network of magical computing devices used solely within the city of Agartha. The Coil leverages a pre-existing network of wiring strung throughout Agartha from ancient times. Data transfer is facilitated through the encoding of messages via the Universal Spell Protocol (USP) invented by Ostanes researcher Arin Park.

Name: (the) Evil Eye
Entry: A mythical entity, presumably a Demon, who is said to be the origin of all Demons. According to Obscurian myth, being caught under the gaze of the Evil Eye causes the subject to be cursed, and depending on the subject, that curse may take phyiscal form.

Name: Admin Branch
Entry: The executive function of AEIOU, performing bureaucratic responsibilities.

Name: AEIOU
Entry:
The governing body of Agartha which consists of 5 branches:
  -The Admin Branch
  -The Extermination Branch - AKA "Exterminators"
  -The Iconoclast Branch
  -The Ostanes Branch
  -The Utility Branch

Name: Armica
Entry: A country within the North Armican continent. Early humans first migrated to the continent 12,000 years ago across the Bering land bridge. From the early 16th century on, various nations colonized parts of the continent (including the Spanish, French, and British, to name a few). This would eventually lead to a revolution by the colonies of Armica against their ruling monarchies, resulting in the formation of the sovereign nation of Armica.

Name: Boat Noodles (kuaitiao ruea)
Entry: A noodle dish orginating from the canals of Thailand. Usually containing pork or beef in a thick soup seasoned with pig or cow blood and spices.

Name: Clarke
Entry: The Typocrypha's AI Clerk, designed to assist users in the operation of their Typocrypha device.

Name: Demon
Entry: Magical creatures originating from the magical flying city of Agartha. Varying greatly in biology, behavior, and magical capabilities, Demons represent the myths and stories they were born from. The origin of Demons is not yet fully understood, however legends suggest Demons are born from an entity known as The Evil Eye when it consumes those myths and stories.

Name: Extermination Branch
Entry: The primary Demon extermination force, organized further into different suborganizations. The Exterminators additionally oversee the AEIOU Academy which trains new cadets.

Name: Magical Computing Device
Entry:
The general term for computing devices that rely on magical signals in addition to electrical signals. Pioneered by Ostanes through their research on the magical properties of the flying city of Agartha. 

Use of the term "magic" is debated for its lack of technical specificity.

Name: Obscurai
Entry: The indigenous people of the magical flying city of Agartha, known for their innate magical abilities.

Name: Ostanes
Entry:
An Armican multinational technology conglomerate, known primarily for driving the research and development of magical computing devices most notably, the Typocrypha). 

Ostanes was founded by Austin Steiner originally as a company specializing in networking devices. Steiner's early investment in the colonization of the magical flying city of Agartha would lead to the expansion of their business into research of magical computing devices, solidfying themselves as a pioneer in the space.

Name: Revolving Boy Juuto
Entry: A Japanese anime following exchange student Juuto Maruizawa and his battles against the oppressive student council, who try to have Juuto expelled. The series was canceled partway after the production studio, Studio Spin, went bankrupt, airing only 10 of the planned 12 episodes. Since the original show run, several well known speculative endings (largely fan created) have been released, which have cemented the series as a cult hit.

Name: Spell
Entry: An acronym for "Serialized Prophetic Energy-level Lattice." By channeling magic energy through electronic circuits, a single instance of magically encoded information - the "Spell" - is generated, and can be used for various applications. The concept was originally invented by Arin Park in development of the Universal Spell Protocol (USP) used in the Typocrypha.

Name: TIPS
Entry: An acronym for Typocrypha Information Presentation System. A program on the Typocrypha which allows users to search informational entries via the Coil. The high speed and universal availability the Coil provided (within the city of Agartha) led to the preference of TIPS as a search tool over traditional electronic networking solutions.

Name: Typocrypha
Entry: A class of magical computing devices that utilize free-text input peripherals. The original Typocrypha was invented in 2011 by technology conglomerate Ostanes to combat Demons. While originally designed purely for combat against magical beings, modern Typocrypha have been augmented with various general use functionality (communicators, Coil search, navigation, etc).

Name: Utility Branch
Entry:
(redirected from "Underdogs")

Manages the supporting infrastructure and civil services of Agartha, including waste management, water, electricity, weather control, agriculture, flight systems, and traffic management.
